title: Drupal Mountain Camp 2024
content:
We are thrilled to announce the 4th edition of , taking place from March 7th to March 10th, 2024, in Davos, Switzerland. Drupal Mountain Camp

Featuring seven different tracks (three parallel), focusing not only on Drupal but also on Symfony, Laravel, PHP, modern JavaScript (React), as well as accessibility, diversity, and inclusion, the conference will be a great opportunity to learn, connect, and share with the community. About the Conference

Drupal Mountain Camp brings together experts and newcomers in web development to share their knowledge in creating interactive websites using Drupal and related web technologies. We are committed to unite a diverse crowd from different disciplines such as developers, designers, project managers as well as agency and community leaders.

Embrace the beauty of the Swiss Alps during the snowy season. Enjoy like skiing, snowboarding, sledding, and indulging in traditional fondue high up in the mountains. It's not just a conference; it's an adventure! Winter Wonderland in Davossocial activities


Although the conference is predominately focused on Drupal, this years' edition we've expanded to several non-Drupal tracks, thus we invite everyone related to PHP or the modern web to participate. Who should join?

Davos is located high up in the Swiss alps, reachable from Zurich airport within a beautiful 2 hours train ride up the mountains.

  • Date: March 7 - 10, 2024
  • Location: Davos, Switzerland
  • Language: English

Submit a session, register as a participant, or become a sponsor today. Keep in touch via our website at: Interested?
